$comment: ReGenesis: a live game on a shared droplet tree, master, several sessions a day. The runner commits below HOLD and the main session at HOLD or on the owner's ask; only the pusher or the main session pushes. Usage is judged per meter (its ADR 0004): the session meter strands in-flight agents, so it holds earlier than the weekly one. Its four legacy docs folders are exempt from the cap and the index check (its ADR 0003, item 3).
